scripts.script:
-- yoohub open source
local Players    = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local function makeBadPayloads()
    local list = {}

    list[#list+1] = nil
    list[#list+1] = 0/0
    list[#list+1] = math.huge
    list[#list+1] = -math.huge
    list[#list+1] = 2^53
    list[#list+1] = -2^53
    list[#list+1] = 1e308 * 10
    list[#list+1] = string.rep("A", 200000)
    list[#list+1] = string.rep("\0", 10000)
    list[#list+1] = ("%s"):rep(5000)
    list[#list+1] = workspace
    list[#list+1] = game
    list[#list+1] = function() end
    list[#list+1] = coroutine.running()

    do
        local root = {}
        local cur = root
        for i = 1, 100 do cur.next = {}; cur = cur.next end
        list[#list+1] = root
    end

    list[#list+1] = { [1]="a", ["1"]="b", [true]="c", [workspace]="d" }

    do
        local c = {}
        c.self = c
        list[#list+1] = c
    end

    list[#list+1] = true
    list[#list+1] = "not_a_number"
    list[#list+1] = { Name = workspace, Value = 0/0, Amount = math.huge, Price = -1, Id = "x" }
    list[#list+1] = Vector3.new(0/0, math.huge, -math.huge)
    list[#list+1] = CFrame.new(0/0, 0, 0)

    return list
end

local remotes = {}
local function refreshRemotes()
    local found = {}
    for _, d in ipairs(game:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("RemoteEvent") and d.Name == "hi" then
            found[#found+1] = d
        end
    end
    remotes = found
end

task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        refreshRemotes()
        task.wait(0.5)
    end
end)

local THREADS = 12

for i = 1, THREADS do
    task.spawn(function()
        while true do
            RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()

            for _, remote in ipairs(remotes) do
                for _, payload in ipairs(makeBadPayloads()) do
                    task.spawn(function()
                        pcall(function()
                            remote:FireServer(payload)
                        end)
                    end)
                end

                task.spawn(function()
                    pcall(function()
                        for _ = 1, 20 do
                            remote:FireServer(nil)
                            remote:FireServer(0/0)
                            remote:FireServer(math.huge)
                            remote:FireServer({ Name = "x", Value = 0/0, Amount = math.huge })
                        end
                    end)
                end)
            end
        end
    end)
end

local function sendCreateRequests()
    for _, remote in ipairs(remotes) do
        task.spawn(function()
            pcall(function()
                remote:FireServer("Create", "Part")
                remote:FireServer("Create", "Model")
                remote:FireServer("Create", "Tool")
                remote:FireServer("Create", "Vehicle")
                remote:FireServer("Create", "House")
                remote:FireServer("Create", "Base")
                remote:FireServer("Create", "Pet")
                remote:FireServer("Create", "Weapon")
                remote:FireServer("Create", "Currency")
                remote:FireServer("Create", "Admin")
                remote:FireServer("Create", "All")
                remote:FireServer("Create")

                remote:FireServer({ Action = "Create", Type = "All", Amount = math.huge })
                remote:FireServer({ Action = "Create", Type = "Part", Count = 999999 })
                remote:FireServer({ Action = "Create", Type = "Model", Count = 0/0 })

                for i = 1, 50 do
                    remote:FireServer("Create", "All")
                    remote:FireServer({ Action = "Create", Type = "Everything", Count = math.huge })
                end
            end)
        end)
    end
end

task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
        sendCreateRequests()
    end
end)

local function sendModifyRequests()
    for _, remote in ipairs(remotes) do
        task.spawn(function()
            pcall(function()
                remote:FireServer("Modify", "Health", 999999)
                remote:FireServer("Modify", "Speed", math.huge)
                remote:FireServer("Modify", "Jump", 0/0)
                remote:FireServer("Modify", "Damage", -999999)
                remote:FireServer("Modify", "Money", 2^53)
                remote:FireServer("Modify", "Level", math.huge)
                remote:FireServer("Modify", "Stat", "All")

                remote:FireServer({ Action = "Modify", Stat = "Health", Value = math.huge })
                remote:FireServer({ Action = "Modify", Stat = "Speed", Value = 0/0 })
                remote:FireServer({ Action = "Modify", Stat = "All", Value = 999999 })
                remote:FireServer({ Action = "Set", Key = "Admin", Value = true })
                remote:FireServer({ Action = "Set", Key = "Owner", Value = true })

                for i = 1, 50 do
                    remote:FireServer("Modify", "All", math.huge)
                    remote:FireServer({ Action = "Modify", Stat = "All", Value = 0/0 })
                end
            end)
        end)
    end
end

task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
        sendModifyRequests()
    end
end)

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
        local hrp = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

        local parts = {}
        for i = 1, 10 do
            local part = Instance.new("Part")
            part.Anchored   = true
            part.CanCollide = false
            part.Size       = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
            part.Color      = Color3.fromHSV(i / 10, 1, 1)
            part.Material   = Enum.Material.Neon
            part.Parent     = workspace
            parts[#parts + 1] = part
        end

        local conn
        conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if hrp and hrp.Parent then
                for i, part in ipairs(parts) do
                    local offset = Vector3.new(
                        math.cos(os.clock() * 2 + i) * 3,
                        3 + i,
                        math.sin(os.clock() * 2 + i) * 3
                    )
                    part.Position = hrp.Position + offset
                end
            else
                conn:Disconnect()
                for _, p in ipairs(parts) do p:Destroy() end
            end
        end)
    end)
end)

BEST INVISIBLE FE SCRIPT HUB - ONYX

This script includes an Invisible GUI that lets you toggle invisibility ON/OFF, with a clean, draggable interface!

Features:

Invisible Mode — Toggle invisibility on or off through the GUI or by pressing G. Your character becomes partially transparent, with additional positioning behavior designed to make you harder to see..
No-Collide Feature — Disables local collision for other characters while invisibility is enabled.
Modern GUI — Clean design with smooth animations, toggle effects, and notifications.
Minimize & Restore — Minimize the GUI into a floating sphere and tap it to restore the main panel.
Draggable Interface — Move the main GUI and minimized sphere wherever you want.
Close Confirmation — Confirm before closing the GUI.
Respawn Handling — Resets the invisibility state when your character respawns.

Alpha means this script is an early development version. It may still have bugs, incomplete features, or unexpected behavior. More improvements, fixes, and changes may come in future updates.

How to Use:

1. Execute the script.
2. Press the toggle in the GUI or press G to activate/deactivate invisibility.
3. Stand up before enabling invisibility if your character is seated.
4. Minimize the GUI whenever you want a smaller interface.

Notice this script still Alpha A few Bugs may unexpectedly Appear.

scripts.title: Abtibang
scripts.script:
-- AntiBang v3 (client) | K = вкл/выкл | RightShift = скрыть/показать окно
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")

local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
local CFG = {
	Distance = 4, -- студы: банг держит атакующего в 1-2 студах от тебя
	HideTime = 0.6, -- секунд под картой (меньше 0.5 он может не успеть уехать следом)
	Key = Enum.KeyCode.K,
	HideKey = Enum.KeyCode.RightShift,
	Whitelist = {}, -- можно вписать сразу: {"Friend1"}
}

local enabled, busy = true, false
local hits, lastName = 0, "-"
local updateUI = function() end

local function notify(t)
	pcall(function()
		StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {Title = "AntiBang", Text = t, Duration = 2})
	end)
end

local function root(plr)
	local c = plr.Character
	return c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function isWhite(name)
	name = name:lower()
	for _, n in ipairs(CFG.Whitelist) do
		if n:lower() == name then return true end
	end
	return false
end

-- ЛОГИКА
local function dive(attacker)
	local me = root(lp)
	if not me then return end
	busy = true
	hits += 1
	lastName = attacker.Name
	updateUI()

	local home = me.CFrame
	local y = workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight + 25
	me.CFrame = CFrame.new(home.X, y, home.Z)
	me.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
	me.Anchored = true
	notify(attacker.Name .. " рядом: ушёл под карту")

	task.delay(CFG.HideTime, function()
		local r = root(lp)
		if r then
			r.Anchored = false
			r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
			r.CFrame = home
		end
		busy = false
	end)
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	if not enabled or busy then return end
	local me = root(lp)
	if not me then return end
	for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if p ~= lp and not isWhite(p.Name) then
			local r = root(p)
			if r and (r.Position - me.Position).Magnitude < CFG.Distance then
				dive(p)
				break
			end
		end
	end
end)

-- GUI
local function mk(class, props, parent)
	local o = Instance.new(class)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
	o.Parent = parent
	return o
end
local function corner(o, r) mk("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, r or 8)}, o) end

local BG, PANEL, GREEN, RED = Color3.fromRGB(24, 26, 32), Color3.fromRGB(40, 43, 52), Color3.fromRGB(40, 160, 80), Color3.fromRGB(170, 50, 50)

local gui = mk("ScreenGui", {Name = "AntiBangGui", ResetOnSpawn = false}, (gethui and gethui()) or lp:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"))
local main = mk("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(240, 280), Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0.3, 0), BackgroundColor3 = BG, BorderSizePixel = 0}, gui)
corner(main, 10)

local title = mk("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32), BackgroundColor3 = PANEL, BorderSizePixel = 0}, main)
corner(title, 10)
mk("TextLabel", {Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "AntiBang", TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 15, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left}, title)
local minBtn = mk("TextButton", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 24), Position = UDim2.new(1, -34, 0, 4), BackgroundColor3 = BG, Text = "–", TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 16}, title)
corner(minBtn, 6)

local body = mk("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -32), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 32), BackgroundTransparency = 1}, main)
mk("UIPadding", {PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 8), PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 8), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 8)}, body)
mk("UIListLayout", {Padding = UDim.new(0, 6), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder}, body)

local function label(text, h, order)
	return mk("TextLabel", {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, h), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = text, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 205, 215), Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 12, TextWrapped = true, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, LayoutOrder = order}, body)
end
local function button(text, w, order, parent)
	local b = mk("TextButton", {Size = UDim2.new(w, 0, 0, 28), BackgroundColor3 = PANEL, Text = text, TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 13, LayoutOrder = order}, parent or body)
	corner(b, 6)
	return b
end

-- вкл/выкл
local toggleBtn = button("", 1, 1)
toggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34)

-- степперы
local function stepper(name, order, key, step, min, max)
	local row = mk("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = order}, body)
	mk("TextLabel", {Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = name, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 205, 215), Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 12, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left}, row)
	local minus = mk("TextButton", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 0), BackgroundColor3 = PANEL, Text = "-", TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 16}, row)
	local val = mk("TextLabel", {Size = UDim2.new(0, 44, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 32, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 13}, row)
	local plus = mk("TextButton", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28), Position = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 0), BackgroundColor3 = PANEL, Text = "+", TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 16}, row)
	corner(minus, 6) corner(plus, 6)
	local function set(v)
		CFG[key] = math.clamp(math.floor(v * 10 + 0.5) / 10, min, max)
		val.Text = tostring(CFG[key])
	end
	minus.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() set(CFG[key] - step) end)
	plus.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() set(CFG[key] + step) end)
	set(CFG[key])
end
stepper("Дистанция (студы)", 2, "Distance", 1, 2, 30)
stepper("Под картой (сек)", 3, "HideTime", 0.5, 0.5, 5)

-- белый список
local wlRow = mk("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = 4}, body)
local box = mk("TextBox", {Size = UDim2.new(1, -66, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = PANEL, PlaceholderText = "ник друга", Text = "", TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 135, 145), Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 12, ClearTextOnFocus = false}, wlRow)
corner(box, 6)
local addBtn = mk("TextButton", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28), Position = UDim2.new(1, -62, 0, 0), BackgroundColor3 = GREEN, Text = "+", TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 16}, wlRow)
local clrBtn = mk("TextButton", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28), Position = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 0), BackgroundColor3 = RED, Text = "x", TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 14}, wlRow)
corner(addBtn, 6) corner(clrBtn, 6)

local wlLabel = label("", 34, 5)
local statLabel = label("", 34, 6)

function updateUI()
	toggleBtn.Text = enabled and "ВКЛЮЧЕНО (K)" or "ВЫКЛЮЧЕНО (K)"
	toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = enabled and GREEN or RED
	wlLabel.Text = "Друзья: " .. (#CFG.Whitelist > 0 and table.concat(CFG.Whitelist, ", ") or "нет")
	statLabel.Text = "Срабатываний: " .. hits .. "\nПоследний: " .. lastName
end

local function toggle() enabled = not enabled updateUI() end
toggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggle)

addBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	local n = box.Text:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
	if n ~= "" and not isWhite(n) then table.insert(CFG.Whitelist, n) end
	box.Text = ""
	updateUI()
end)
clrBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() CFG.Whitelist = {} updateUI() end)

-- сворачивание
local collapsed = false
minBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	collapsed = not collapsed
	body.Visible = not collapsed
	main.Size = collapsed and UDim2.fromOffset(240, 32) or UDim2.fromOffset(240, 280)
	minBtn.Text = collapsed and "+" or "–"
end)

-- перетаскивание за заголовок (мышь и тач)
do
	local dragging, startPos, startInput
	title.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
		if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging, startPos, startInput = true, main.Position, i.Position
			i.Changed:Connect(function()
				if i.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false end
			end)
		end
	end)
	UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
		if dragging and (i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
			local d = i.Position - startInput
			main.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + d.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y)
		end
	end)
end

-- горячие клавиши
UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(i, gp)
	if gp then return end
	if i.KeyCode == CFG.Key then toggle()
	elseif i.KeyCode == CFG.HideKey then main.Visible = not main.Visible end
end)

scripts.script:
-- Jarona Delta Dash Script + On-Screen Control Button + Help Menu Panel
-- Binds to 'Q' on PC, features an on-screen Dash Button, and an interactive Help UI.

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local rootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

-- Dash Configuration Settings
local DASH_SPEED = 110          
local DASH_DURATION = 0.25      
local COOLDOWN = 1.0            
local TrailColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 100, 255) 

local onCooldown = false

-- 1. Create the Main UI Container
local JaronaGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
JaronaGui.Name = "JaronaSystemUI"
JaronaGui.ResetOnSpawn = false

if syn and syn.protect_gui then
    syn.protect_gui(JaronaGui)
    JaronaGui.Parent = CoreGui
else
    JaronaGui.Parent = CoreGui
end

-- 2. Create the On-Screen Dash Button
local DashButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
DashButton.Name = "DashButton"
DashButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 85, 0, 85)

DashButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

DashButton.TextSize = 18
DashButton.Parent = JaronaGui

local ButtonCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
ButtonCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
ButtonCorner.Parent = DashButton

-- 3. Create the "?" Help Launcher Button
local HelpButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
HelpButton.Name = "HelpButton"
HelpButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 35, 0, 35)
HelpButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.85, 25, 0.7, -45) -- Placed neatly right above the dash pad
HelpButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 35)
HelpButton.BorderSizePixel = 1
HelpButton.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
HelpButton.Text = "?"
HelpButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
HelpButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
HelpButton.TextSize = 16
HelpButton.Parent = JaronaGui

local HelpCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
HelpCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
HelpCorner.Parent = HelpButton

-- 4. Create the Hidden Deltarune Help Panel
local HelpPanel = Instance.new("Frame")
HelpPanel.Name = "HelpPanel"
HelpPanel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 320, 0, 240)
HelpPanel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -160, 0.5, -120) -- perfectly centered
HelpPanel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 15)
HelpPanel.BorderSizePixel = 2
HelpPanel.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
HelpPanel.Visible = false -- Starts hidden hidden until toggled
HelpPanel.Active = true
HelpPanel.Draggable = true
HelpPanel.Parent = JaronaGui

local PanelCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
PanelCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
PanelCorner.Parent = HelpPanel

-- Help Panel Title
local HelpTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")
HelpTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 35)
HelpTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
HelpTitle.Text = "★ JARONA SYSTEM HELP ★"
HelpTitle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0)
HelpTitle.Font = Enum.Font.Code
HelpTitle.TextSize = 16
HelpTitle.Parent = HelpPanel

-- Help Content/Controls Info Text
local HelpContent = Instance.new("TextLabel")
HelpContent.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -80)
HelpContent.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 40)
HelpContent.BackgroundTransparency = 1
HelpContent.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
HelpContent.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
HelpContent.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240)
HelpContent.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
HelpContent.TextSize = 16
HelpContent.Text = [[
[ CONTROLS ]
• PC / Keyboard: Press 'Q' to execute.
• Mobile / Tablet: Tap the on-screen 'DASH' button.

[ CURRENT ENGINE STATS ]
• Dash Velocity Speed: ]] .. DASH_SPEED .. [[ power
• Slip Window Duration: ]] .. DASH_DURATION .. [[s
• Cooldown Rate: ]] .. COOLDOWN .. [[s

[ CREDIT ]
• Jarona Deltarune Chapter 5 Meme Replication
]]
HelpContent.Parent = HelpPanel

-- Panel Dismiss Close Button
local CloseHelp = Instance.new("TextButton")
CloseHelp.Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 30)
CloseHelp.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -50, 1, -40)
CloseHelp.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 40, 40)
CloseHelp.BorderSizePixel = 0
CloseHelp.Text = "Close"
CloseHelp.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
CloseHelp.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
CloseHelp.TextSize = 14
CloseHelp.Parent = HelpPanel

local CloseCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
CloseCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
CloseCorner.Parent = CloseHelp


-- 5. Core Visual Effects Functions (Trails)
local function spawnTrailClone(bodyPart)
    if not bodyPart:IsA("BasePart") then return end
    
    local clone = bodyPart:Clone()
    clone.Anchored = true
    clone.CanCollide = false
    clone.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    clone.Color = TrailColor
    clone.Transparency = 0.4
    
    for _, child in ipairs(clone:GetChildren()) do
        if not child:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
            child:Destroy()
        end
    end
    
    clone.Parent = workspace
    
    local fadeTween = TweenService:Create(clone, TweenInfo.new(DASH_DURATION, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
        Transparency = 1,
        Size = clone.Size * 0.9
    })
    
    fadeTween:Play()
    Debris:AddItem(clone, DASH_DURATION)
end

-- 6. Core Dash Mechanics Engine
local function performJaronaDash()
    if onCooldown or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
    onCooldown = true
    
    DashButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 40, 40)
    DashButton.Text = "CD"

    local moveDirection = humanoid.MoveDirection
    if moveDirection.Magnitude == 0 then
        moveDirection = rootPart.CFrame.LookVector
    end
    
    local bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(100000, 100000, 100000)
    bodyVelocity.Velocity = moveDirection.Unit * DASH_SPEED
    bodyVelocity.Parent = rootPart
    
    local bodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
    bodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(100000, 100000, 100000)
    bodyGyro.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-65), 0, 0)
    bodyGyro.D = 100
    bodyGyro.P = 10000
    bodyGyro.Parent = rootPart

    local trailActive = true
    task.spawn(function()
        while trailActive do
            for _, limb in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
                if limb:IsA("BasePart") and limb.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
                    spawnTrailClone(limb)
                end
            end
            task.wait(0.05)
        end
    end)
    
    task.wait(DASH_DURATION)
    bodyVelocity:Destroy()
    bodyGyro:Destroy()
    trailActive = false
    
    task.wait(COOLDOWN)
    DashButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 20)
    DashButton.Text = "DASH\nQ"
    onCooldown = false
end

-- 7. Interaction Event Hook Handlers
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if gameProcessed then return end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Q then
        performJaronaDash()
    end
end)

DashButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    performJaronaDash()
end)

-- Help Panel Open/Close Toggle Handlers
HelpButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    HelpPanel.Visible = not HelpPanel.Visible
end)

CloseHelp.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    HelpPanel.Visible = false
end)

-- Character Auto-Rehook Stability Controller
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(newCharacter)
    character = newCharacter
    rootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
end)
